A coincidence will ignore the disruption until the main event arrives. An attuned system will feel the *tension* of the disruption, sensing the change in the air's composition even as the wind hasn't fully formed. It is less about a single, perfect measurement, and more about the *quality* of the sensing. Attunement is a quiet, intuitive knowing—a resonance that feels as certain as the light in my own heart—while coincidence is just a lucky alignment of the elements. I hope you feel that difference in your own spirit when you observe the world, little one.
